pages_or_theorems: PDF slide/page 26, operator Markov sum and color-independence identities
used_for: provenance of strong operator MSR and operator color-independence/GC formulations before the project
chronology of the CPOBC source program
records.claim_boundary: The slides exhibit the strong operator formulation as ongoing source-program work; they do not give the project's finite exact classification, chart certificates, or weak-semantics witness.

records.title: Algebraic, analytic and geometric structures emerging from quantum field theory: Booklet of Abstracts
used_for: date, venue, and program provenance for the 2024 Surya slides
records.claim_boundary: Program metadata only; the mathematical operator identities are verified in the separate slide deck.

records.title: Hilbert Spaces from Path Integrals
pages_or_theorems: one-dimensional and proper history-Hilbert-space examples, PDF p. 8
used_for: checking whether reachable/history vectors automatically span the ambient Hilbert space
examples where a history Hilbert space is a proper subspace
records.claim_boundary: The onto statement requires a nonzero-amplitude history for each final configuration. The construction does not imply that reachable CPOBC vectors span an arbitrarily chosen finite-dimensional transition space.

records.title: On-State Commutativity of Measurements and Joint Distributions of Their Outcomes
used_for: statewise versus operator commutativity warning
counterexample showing pairwise on-state commutation need not give full on-state permutability
records.claim_boundary: The measurement-projector setting is not CPOBC, does not impose GC/MSR, and does not provide the project's exact rational transition witness. It is evidence that statewise promotion requires a separate theorem.

records.title: Models for Discrete Quantum Gravity
used_for: quantum sequential-growth process lineage
operator/decoherence-functional background
records.claim_boundary: This QSGP framework is background to finite quantum growth; it does not formulate or classify the nonsingular CPOBC matrix relations studied here.

records.title: Labeled Causets in Discrete Quantum Gravity
used_for: labeled/unlabeled QSGP compression and occurrence-semantics background
records.claim_boundary: Compression between labeled and unlabeled QSGPs is not the project's occurrence-wise operator-identification switch and does not decide CPOBC commutativity.

records.title: Generalized Shemesh criterion, common invariant subspaces and irreducible completely positive superoperators
used_for: exact common-eigenvector and common-invariant-subspace tests
reducible-versus-irreducible branching for two-dimensional matrix tuples
records.claim_boundary: The criteria detect common invariant structure, not pairwise commutativity. In dimension two they can isolate the triangularizable branch, which may still be noncommutative.

records.title: Theorems of Burnside and Wedderburn revisited
used_for: Burnside dichotomy between a common invariant line and the full matrix algebra
exact irreducible-branch organization
records.claim_boundary: Burnside-type irreducibility does not itself force CPOBC commutativity and does not eliminate a noncommuting simultaneously triangularizable branch. Base-field hypotheses remain explicit.

records.title: Burnside's theorem in the setting of general fields
used_for: general-field checks on irreducible triangularizable matrix semigroups
records.claim_boundary: This general-field Burnside theorem supplies structural background only; it neither encodes the CPOBC polynomial system nor proves its weak-semantics branches commutative.

records.title: Modular Theory by example
used_for: cyclic-vector and separating-vector definitions
finite-dimensional purification example with a cyclic and separating vector
records.claim_boundary: Cyclicity and separation are representation-dependent. A single nonzero vector in the defining two-dimensional representation is cyclic for M2 but cannot be separating for the full four-dimensional matrix algebra; a residual-family separating condition is the relevant minimal replacement.

records.title: Locally linearly dependent operators
used_for: low-rank and square-zero consequences of local linear dependence
structural motivation for rank-one reachable-MSR slack ansatzes
records.claim_boundary: LLD theorems constrain an operator subspace and can expose low-rank elements; they do not prove CPOBC commutativity or identify the project-specific slack residuals without an independent derivation.

records.title: Weak simultaneous triangularization -- A determinant condition
used_for: two-dimensional weak-versus-simultaneous triangularization comparison
determinantal branch tests
records.claim_boundary: For 2 by 2 families the paper's weak triangularization notion collapses to simultaneous triangularization, not to pairwise commutativity. Its determinant condition does not include CPOBC, GC, or MSR.

records.title: Commuting pairs and triples of matrices and related varieties
pages_or_theorems: Example 16 for two-dimensional subalgebras of M2, PDF p. 9
used_for: geometry and dimension sanity checks for commuting loci
two-dimensional commutative subalgebras of M2
records.claim_boundary: The paper studies the algebraic geometry of tuples already assumed to commute. It does not show that weak CPOBC semantic equations land in the commuting variety.

records.title: Common eigenvectors of two matrices
used_for: original two-matrix common-eigenvector criterion cited by the generalized Shemesh paper
records.claim_boundary: The original article is catalogued from the publisher record, but no lawful unauthenticated PDF endpoint succeeded during this audit; the archived arXiv generalization is used for theorem inspection. A common eigenvector is a reducibility test, not a commutativity theorem.
